acceptance.criterion_verbatim: The invalidation pipeline runs in the spec's order (coarse intersection -> exclusion replay -> residual -> policy) and OVER-includes by construction (m2 fires on under-inclusion).

acceptance.output_evidence: The four stages execute as a literal code sequence in the spec's order and every record carries pipeline_order verbatim. OVER-inclusion is two-sided: a declared coordinate set that under-includes the full set is REFUSED (m2: 'declared coarse intersection UNDER-includes -- missing coordinate(s) [...]'), and an UNREADABLE side counts as intersecting (a retrieval failure can only ADD to the intersection, never shrink it). m2 FIRED in the battery.
